create_pinecone_client: create a Pinecone vector database client with gRPC support and automatic index initialization
insert_vectors_collection: insert a list of vector items into a named Pinecone collection in parallel batches
upsert_vectors_collection: upsert a list of vector items into a named Pinecone collection, creating or overwriting existing entries
search_similar_vectors: search for similar vectors in a collection using cosine similarity with metadata filtering
delete_collection_vectors: delete all vectors in a collection or specific vectors by IDs or metadata filter
